name: Hester Quaile
note: Speaker of the Tidemark League and harbourmistress of Tollhaven (world doc v1.69 §3.7), who tolls everything that comes in under the chain, and a question if you ask it twice. Stands by the Paid Toll's door. Takes in Consigned; gives Low Water, Letters of Marque and Brine Cross. (Not Hester Lowe, the Vale's beekeeper: hester.ink is hers.)
